newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.98 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.98 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Thursday, July 17, was fixed at 20.9800 percent, or a rise of 3.00 basis points from 20.9500 percent, the rate for July 16, Banco de Mexico said on Wednesday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day, and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Thursday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
The weekly revised 91-day TIIE rate rose 96.00 basis points to 21.2450 percent on Wednesday from 20.2850 percent the week before.
The 28-day TIIP rate, also revised weekly, meanwhile rose 144.32 basis points to 21.0129 percent on Wednesday from 19.5697 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
